levels.surface: أبو عبد الله محمد بن خالد

notes: «يقال» and «قراءة» are reading-mode glosses, left out. «[عن]» is a bracketed insertion and is not a link of its own.
The saying is a long scene with Amir al-Mu'minin speaking; the report itself is narrated by «أبيه» (the last link), so the scene is not a separate isnad.
